verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation (triggers, change streams, rules) is a fair axis for a database or search service, so it applies. The evidence shows no documented way to define rules that fire actions on events. Conditional writes and patch/delete-by-filter are request-time write controls, not event-triggered rules, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
